static_traits.name: Natalie
static_traits.family_status: Living alone；Mother曾是伦敦的知名芭蕾舞Actor
static_traits.social_status: 有少数朋友，但not yet与其讨论not安；搬到新城市后社交受影响，难以建立有意义的连接
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；not yet接受心理治疗；without类似问题史

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得由于自己在加油站当收银员，do not人都把我看成懒惰的人，这让我产生not安全感和Self-doubt。
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询，因为这些not安全感正在影响我的社交互动和整体幸福感。
growth_experiences: Mother曾是伦敦的著名芭蕾舞Actor；来访者在成长与成人后期将Mother的成功职业作为比较参照，报告中明确指出：当她把自己的工作与Mother的成功职业进行比较时，压力水平上升，trigger自卑与not安全感。

About a year ago he moved to a new city and began working as a cashier at a gas station; since then feelings of being judged by others and self-doubt appeared and intensified, appearing mainly several times a week in social scenes or when meeting new friends; although he tried to prove his own worth by working harder and increasing social activities, these feelings persist.

core_beliefs: 我的价值取决于工作是否体面与职业地位

special_situations.event: In social settings or when meeting new friends谈到自己的工作是Gas station cashier
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的工作not体面，do not人就会认为我懒惰、缺乏抱负
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Working harder at work and increasing social activities to prove oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们一定觉得我很懒、not上进

special_situations.event: 将自己的工作与Mother作为著名芭蕾舞Actor的成功事业进行比较
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我达not到Mother的成就，就说明我失败、not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 为自己设定僵化规则：“我not应该在加油站工作”

special_situations.event: After moving to a new city, starting a gas station cashier job in the new environment
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: In this city, people define a person's value by occupation
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在岗位上更加用力工作以换取他人认可
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 在这里大家都会看not起我

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被他人接纳与认可，not因职业而被贬低
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评判为懒惰或失败，进而Being rejected、失去联系与尊重
defense_goal: 通过Social withdrawal减少被negate的风险
通过过度努力工作来弥补被看低的恐惧

object_relations.self_representation: not如Mother的子Female、带有自卑的自我
object_relations.object_representation: 理想化、成功且高标准的Mother形象

object_relations.self_representation: 容易被评判、需要小心Self-protection的人

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师探询她对他人如何看待自己的信念、或谈及Mother成功与“必须not在加油站工作”等规则时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向将他人的关心或探问理解为对自己not够体面的评判（移情：将他人视作评判者）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use平和、客观的语气，强调事实与功能（如“它能让我付账、提供稳定”），减少情感词汇与自我暴露；若被追问感受，转向谈论实际细节。

manifestations: 难以建立有意义的连接
在When meeting new friends担心他人评价而“not做自己”

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 以Mother的成功为硬性标准衡量自我
形成“我not应该在加油站工作”的僵化规则
用他人眼光界定自我价值

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and introspection, involving excessive self-restriction and self-reproach, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 在社交中高度担心他人看法而变得拘谨与Withdrawal
not yet向朋友表达自己的not安与感受

positive_force: 有几位朋友可作为潜在支持
对咨询持开放态度，愿意尝试行为实验
Able to perform cognitive reappraisal (seeing work as providing stability and financial support for current needs)
negative_force: 持续的与Mother成功的比较带来压力与自卑
读心术与过度概括等认知扭曲
Takes external evaluation and occupational respectability as rigid rules of self-worth
低自尊与not安全感导致Social withdrawal
not愿与朋友讨论not安，支持利用not足

target_behavior.behavior: 在社交场合因害怕被评价为懒惰而Withdrawal与紧张
antecedent: In social settings or when meeting new friends
当被问及或主动谈到自己的工作是Gas station cashier时
target_behavior.core_reason: 与Mother成功职业的长期比较及认知扭曲（读心术、过度概括）使其将职业体面与自我价值强绑定，产生被评判的Anticipation与Anxiety
target_behavior.function: Avoids and reduces the risk of negative evaluation, maintaining a sense of self-esteem safety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: 难以建立有意义的关系，低自尊与not安全感持续，日常情绪与心情受到影响
